title: R2 HRIS attendance employee self-service and payroll closure
businessRules: All HR and payroll tenant identity comes from authenticated company/branch context; compatibility tenant fields never grant authority.
Work shifts, rosters, policies, corrections, assignments, tax/social profiles, and payroll mappings are operator-managed and audited.
Attendance correction approval is fail-closed for locked payroll attendance and applies only an allowlisted attendance-record patch.
Employee assignments are effective-dated and primary assignment ranges may not overlap.
Employee Telegram/WhatsApp bindings require verification before preferences can be relied upon for sensitive delivery.
Only GROSS tax is currently executable; GROSS_UP and NET remain explicit unsupported/fail-closed until a documented lawful rule is implemented.
Split-period/proration cannot silently guess; payroll calculation requires full effective-dated profile/component coverage and explicit supported proration rules.
Payroll accounting mapping must resolve active branch-owned accounts before posting.
R2 CRITICAL/HIGH findings require GitHub live PostgreSQL/browser evidence before CLOSED.
acceptanceCriteria: F11 WorkShift CRUD is available through permissioned Admin/API with audit evidence.
F12 EmployeeSchedule roster planning is available through permissioned Admin/API.
F13 AttendanceCorrection submit-review-approve/reject applies safely and unblocks payroll only after resolution.
F14 EmployeeAssignment effective-dated placement lifecycle is available and overlap-safe.
F15 AttendancePolicy management is available with validation and audit.
F16 Geofence/device/biometric operator management is available from Admin.
F17 Employee Portal exposes Telegram/WhatsApp verification and notification preferences.
F18 EmployeeTaxProfile and EmployeeSocialSecurityProfile are operator-managed and used by payroll.
F19 PayrollAccountingMapping is operator-managed and validates branch accounts.
F20 unsupported tax methods remain explicit fail-closed rather than falsely calculated.
F21 split-period/proration behavior is explicit and cannot silently under/overpay.
GitHub R2 E2E covers roster, correction, leave/permission/sick, payroll configuration, calculation, approval, posting, settlement, and payslip.
testPlan: R2 payroll posting regression verifies balanced journal debit equals credit and branch-owned accounting mappings.
GitHub R2 runtime probe on live PostgreSQL exact artifact
migrationPlan: Use existing R2 schema models where present. Any required schema changes must be expand-only and provider-parity; this source pass does not remove or rewrite existing columns.
rollbackPlan: Application rollback may stop exposing new operator routes while retaining additive data. Do not destroy HR/payroll configuration or approved correction/assignment history.
monitoringPlan: Audit logs cover configuration and review mutations. Runtime evidence records exact source/build identity and R2 journey results.
securityNotes: Biometric templates remain external references/hashes only; sensitive member/tax identifiers remain secret refs; notification bindings require verification.
